hypothesis: One core lifecycle for parent cancellation and restrictive authority revisions will preserve native workflow quarantine behavior while giving nested native launches a leak-free primitive to adopt.

metricsCompared.name: native invalidation lifecycle cases
metricsCompared.baseline: Parent abort propagation was duplicated by workflow callers and the restrictive-policy watcher was workflow-local without focused parent/listener lifecycle coverage.
metricsCompared.candidate: 5/5 focused helper cases pass for pre-abort, later abort, restrictive comparison, idempotent settlement cleanup, and initialization-failure cleanup.

metricsCompared.name: workflow agent and repair behavior
metricsCompared.baseline: Workflow attempts and repair attempts separately wired parent cancellation around the same policy subscription.
metricsCompared.candidate: 47/47 focused workflow quarantine, repair-loop, and agent-step tests pass through the shared lifecycle.

rationale: The candidate removes duplicated lifecycle wiring while preserving the existing restriction error text and native confirmed-stop quarantine path. Focused tests exercise both invalidation sources and prove deterministic teardown; type, formatting, strict-type, and root-layout guards pass.
